data.narrative:
Lunar Outpost is a Series A space and aerospace company that has raised $23.6M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of 5 public peers (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private-stage companies in the space sector, including SpaceX, Rocket Lab, ICEYE, Sierra Space, and Planet Labs.

Stage-progression methodology is the sole applicable triangulation approach here. Using total capital raised ($23.6M) as a valuation proxy and applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A-to-subsequent-stage progression yields an implied valuation of $47.2M. Peer-median analysis could not be applied due to insufficient comparable companies at identical or adjacent stages within narrow valuation tiers—only 2 adjacent-stage peers were identified in the broader Space & Aerospace sector. Public-comp anchoring via price-to-sales multiples (sector median: 27.4x across the 5 public tickers) was not viable in the absence of disclosed revenue for the target company.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $40M to $54M, centered at $47M. Material uncertainties include the lack of revenue visibility for direct public-multiple triangulation, sparse private-peer data at identical stage and scale, and the typical wide dispersion in early-stage aerospace valuations. The single-method result should be weighted accordingly; additional commercial or technical milestones would strengthen conviction.
